method_description: How GPU prices are collected and compared on {date} UTC: {count}, {models}, {regions}. USD list rates, GPU shares, Spot and history.
method_api: Verified public sources: tier A official APIs, including {source}, may be displayed and exported. B/C pages are display only, fetched at most once per hour per provider. JSON includes only tier A rows with export_allowed. Link-only sources are never fetched.
method_filters: We request Virtual Machines in NC, ND and NV families across all commercial regions with USD currency, Consumption prices and primary meters. Windows, paid Linux license add-ons, Dev/Test, reservations, savings plans, legacy Low Priority, non-hourly, future-effective, zero-price and invalid meters are excluded. Base VM products without a Windows designation are treated as Linux base-OS list rates.
method_mapping: Known exact ARM SKUs map to documented GPU model, GPU count, vCPU and RAM. Unknown SKUs and conflicting same-date rates are logged and skipped. The most recent effective date wins within a collection. L40S and other unverified sizes are not guessed. Curated coverage is not exhaustive.
method_units: FX uses dated ECB reference rates: EUR × USD rate, or CNY × USD rate / CNY rate. Failed refreshes retain the last valid date. Original currency and hourly price remain visible. Monthly prices are never divided into hourly prices.
method_exclusions: Minimum, median and maximum use current, exact USD prices for whole GPUs across all providers, separately for on-demand and Spot. Standard and unspecified regions are eligible; edge and restricted regions are excluded. Unknown tax basis is eligible and labelled; tax-included, fractional, GPU-component-only and advertised starting prices are excluded. GPU-hour rates divide instance rates by GPU count; per-GPU rates retain their scope. Calculations use unrounded values. Minima may refer to different regions or SKUs. Region counts include an unspecified-location group when present. Verda uses public instance types and separate on-demand and Spot fields. Regions and live stock are unknown. CPU core semantics and RAM byte convention are unverified, so their original descriptions are shown. No authenticated availability endpoint is queried.
method_history: Daily history retains the latest observed rate per provider, SKU, region and price type. Minimum, median with sample count and maximum use the same eligible whole-GPU population as headlines, including unspecified regions, with on-demand and Spot kept separate. Missing days are not filled and stale providers are excluded from today. Coverage changes affect the series.
method_snapshot: Stale · latest fetch failed or is from an earlier day. Cheapest among observed offers only. Coverage depends on the last collection; this is not a global-market minimum.
method_network: HTTP uses approved HTTPS endpoints and refuses redirects, without credentials, cookies or browser impersonation. APIs use backoff and Retry-After. Page requests have no automatic retries; every attempt, including failure, consumes the persisted hourly budget. HTTP 403 stops the source.
affiliates: Some links may be affiliate links. This does not affect rankings or prices shown. Provider-only cards carry no scraped price and are excluded from every comparison.
not_found_description: The requested page does not exist. Choose a language to browse observed GPU prices.
basis: Minimum, median and maximum use current, exact USD prices for whole GPUs across all providers, separately for on-demand and Spot. Standard and unspecified regions are eligible; edge and restricted regions are excluded. Unknown tax basis is eligible and labelled; tax-included, fractional, GPU-component-only and advertised starting prices are excluded. GPU-hour rates divide instance rates by GPU count; per-GPU rates retain their scope. Calculations use unrounded values. Minima may refer to different regions or SKUs. Region counts include an unspecified-location group when present.

fraction_note: Fractional GPU, {share} share; price normalized to a full-GPU equivalent. VM hourly price is the actual charge; full-GPU model memory is not the allocated VRAM.

disclosure: Some links may be affiliate links. This does not affect rankings or prices shown.
region_intro: All observed locations are listed below. Whole and fractional allocations are separate. Each price is the minimum within that location and allocation, separated by price type; excluded locations do not enter headline statistics.
region_chart: Cheapest standard regions · whole GPUs · USD/GPU-hour
region_chart_desc: Paired horizontal bars compare on-demand and Spot minima within each eligible region. Missing bars mean no observed price. Labels give the exact displayed values.
sku_intro: Each row is one observed SKU, region and price type. VM USD/hour is the full VM charge. GPU USD/hour divides that charge by GPU count or share. Outbound buttons open official provider documentation or pricing; check quota and capacity with the provider.
faq_cheapest_q: What is the cheapest {model} across providers?
faq_cheapest_a: On-demand: {demand}/GPU-hour. Spot: {spot}/GPU-hour. Separate observed minima across {regions} eligible location groups and {offers} whole-GPU offers on {date} UTC; unspecified locations are included. Capacity and quota are not guaranteed.
faq_spot_q: How does Spot compare with on-demand?
faq_spot_a: {comparison} Spot can be interrupted. The two minimum prices may refer to different regions or SKUs.
faq_units_q: Does this price buy a whole GPU?
faq_units_a: Headline offers use whole GPUs. Cards show the GPU count, instance-hour price and per-GPU-hour price. GPU-component-only rates are labelled separately. Fractional offers show their share and full-GPU-equivalent rate in a separate list.
method_regions: Offers in edge and restricted regions stay visible with badges but do not enter headline comparisons or history. An unspecified region is eligible and labelled “Region not specified by provider”. Unrecognized region IDs default to standard and are logged for review. Restricted badges include sovereign clouds and the conservative exclusion of West India and legacy Jio regions.
method_rounding: Dollar values use two decimals at or above USD 1 and three decimals below USD 1, using unrounded source values for all calculations. Counts n accompany every offer-price median. No discount percentage is displayed when the Spot minimum is at least the on-demand minimum; discounts are never negative.
method_cadence: The workflow may run every 15 minutes; each page provider is fetched at most once per rolling hour. SQLite meta persists the time across runs. Skips retain the observation and collection status. UTC dates and outcomes indicate freshness; missing history days are not filled.
method_audit: Every build independently recalculates published prices and statistics from SQLite, checks JSON exports and localized HTML including titles, descriptions, FAQ structured data and charts, and fails on a mismatch. Optional live sampling compares stored VM prices with Azure; a newer effective date is reported as a source update rather than a historical error.
maximum_def: Maximum = the highest price across the same eligible offers. Models tracked = the number of distinct GPU models represented in today's eligible offers.
link_only_note: Link only. No prices are fetched or exported.
stale_provider: Stale · latest fetch failed or is from an earlier day
note_azure: Azure uses curated Linux GPU SKUs, with primary hourly meters and effective-date checks.
note_linode: Linode joins exact GPU SKUs to the public region/plan availability feed. Regional hourly overrides take priority; VPU devices are excluded. GPU use is rounded up to hours.
note_scaleway: Scaleway uses complete GPU instance rows with hardware metadata. Money units and nanos retain full precision; minutes and seconds are explicitly converted to hours. Legacy aliases, Apple cores and monthly prices are excluded. EUR is converted with dated ECB rates when available; otherwise EUR remains visible without a USD comparison.
note_verda: Verda uses public instance types and separate on-demand and Spot fields. Regions and live stock are unknown. CPU core semantics and RAM byte convention are unverified, so their original descriptions are shown. No authenticated availability endpoint is queried.
todo_vultr: TODO: both catalog pages were fetched. Most GPU rows lack explicit GPU count/type; the three fully typed L40S rows have no locations or regional prices. Regional pricing and partial-GPU semantics remain unverified.
todo_oracle: TODO: the live response has lastUpdated and 668 items, without paging metadata. Verify completeness and join GPU-hour part numbers to official shapes, GPU counts and OCPU/vCPU definitions before enabling. Exclude AI Enterprise software.
todo_ovh: TODO: the live catalog contains plans, products and addons, EUR and tax metadata. Verify the integer monetary multiplier, exact consumption units and regional category joins before enabling.
fx_policy: FX uses dated ECB reference rates: EUR × USD rate, or CNY × USD rate / CNY rate. Failed refreshes retain the last valid date. Original currency and hourly price remain visible. Monthly prices are never divided into hourly prices.
partner_copy: {label}, a VPN service used by the site owner. Referral link: we earn a commission if you buy through it; buyers get 5% off with this link (code {code}).
partner_footer: Referral link: we earn a commission; buyers get 5% off (code {code}).

page_blocked_note: Link only. Plain HTTP requests returned 403; no bypass, collection or price export.
note_featurize: Featurize agreement 7.1/7.3 restricts reuse of site materials: tier C, display only. Record one GPU only if per-card rental is explicit; otherwise show the instance price with unknown count. Preserve CNY and dated ECB conversions.
note_nebius: Nebius prices cover the GPU only; CPU/RAM are billed separately. Starting Spot prices are excluded from headlines. Do not infer GPU counts or memory.
note_lambda: Lambda prices take effect 2026-11-16 at 00:00 UTC and are excluded from current offers before then. Preserve per-GPU prices and explicit counts; exclude cluster commitments.
note_paperspace: Paperspace hourly GPU compute prices are display only. Unknown counts remain unknown. Starting prices, three-year commitments and special promotions retain their conditions and are excluded from headlines.
note_baidu_gpu: Baidu GPU post-paid instance prices are display only. Preserve explicit counts and fractions; exclude prepaid monthly prices. Show CNY originals and dated ECB conversions. Tax basis is unknown.
note_clore: Community marketplace with individual hosts; reliability varies. Whole-server daily USD quotes divided by 24, then by the explicit GPU count. Platform fees may apply.
note_anygpu: Normal hourly CNY package prices; member prices are notes only. GPU allocation is unknown unless explicitly stated.
note_ai_galaxy: Promotional hourly CNY floor prices; allocation and availability unconfirmed. Excluded from headline comparisons.
history_aggregation_note: Past days retain the cheapest offer per provider, GPU model, allocation, price type and region from the latest daily offer observations. Historical distributions use those group representatives; today uses the current listing.
